# Fresh Frame

> A two-person studio in Chennai, India, building websites, branding and
> custom business automation. Founders: Ganesh Kumar (full-stack developer,
> ML) and Vinothini (frontend developer, product).

Fresh Frame builds a real, working mock of a website before any money
changes hands — not a PDF, not a template preview — and the client decides
whether to continue after seeing it, with zero advance owed either way.
Automations (order/enquiry handling, invoicing, reporting, reminders,
follow-ups) are scoped on a call instead, since a workflow can't be judged
in a five-minute browser preview the way a page can.

## Services

- Websites — landing pages, business/portfolio sites, e-commerce stores, custom web apps
- Business automation — built around how the client's business actually works, not an off-the-shelf tool
- Branding — logo, visual identity, brand kit, website copywriting
- Digital solutions — SEO setup, analytics, domain/hosting, maintenance

## How engagements work

- Websites: a free working mock is built from your brief first, with zero advance. You only
  pay if you decide to go ahead after seeing it.
- Automations and custom products: scoped on a call instead of mocked, since a workflow can't
  be judged in a browser preview. You get a written feature list and price before any build work
  (and any payment) begins.
- After launch: domain, hosting and a handover walkthrough are included so the client owns and
  can run the site themselves; ongoing help is available via the Care plan add-on.

## Pricing (India, INR)

- Basic: ₹3,000–6,000 — one page, mobile responsive, WhatsApp/call buttons, photo gallery, basic SEO
- Standard: ₹8,000–15,000 — 3–5 pages, full gallery, Google Maps/reviews, contact form, 2 revision rounds (most chosen tier)
- Premium: ₹15,000–30,000 — everything in Standard, online ordering/booking, own domain, branding, 30 days post-launch support
- Care plan (add-on): ₹500–1,500/month — ongoing maintenance, content changes, cancel anytime
- Automation and custom products are quoted per job after a scoping call
